property_summary: When balanceOfBatch is called with empty arrays (length 0) and accounts.length == ids.length, the reference contract returns an empty array, but the buggy contract reverts due to out-of-bounds read when i <= accounts.length causes i=0 to attempt batchBalances[0] access on an array of length 0.
change_summary: Replace the for-loop increment from i < accounts.length to i <= accounts.length to cause an out-of-bounds read (or revert), changing the return value on success.
